nom: TATCHA The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily T-zone says the polish keeps oil balanced without over-drying that area.
segments.dry: Reviewers describe it as effective for dry skin, smoothing and brightening within about a week, though a few others report it left their skin dried out or stripped.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with eczema or rosacea, report gentle daily or every-other-day use with no irritation, redness, or stinging.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her mid-50s and another noting a more youthful look credit regular use with smoother, firmer-looking skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with an oily T-zone and drier surrounding skin reports the product balances both areas at once.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report skin looking smoother, brighter and years younger with regular use, though these are subjective impressions rather than measured results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without stripping or drying the skin, but several others explicitly report it left their skin dried out, including one who found it more drying than a prior version.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report calming of redness and no irritation after use.
concerns.barrier: One long-term user states it is the only exfoliant that doesn't disturb her moisture barrier; others corroborate a non-stripping feel, but a few report abrasiveness or dryness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports pore appearance improved and looking less noticeable after use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, and one credits it with evening out scars; this is not universal, as some reviewers report no such change.
concerns.oiliness: A reviewer with an oily T-zone reports the product helps keep oil production balanced relative to the rest of the face.
